source.source_locator: 消防法 第13条の24第1項

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 危険物保安監督者が法令等に違反した場合、市町村長等は所有者等に解任を命ずることができる。
evidence.tested_misconception: 監督者の違反に対しては免状返納制度しかなく、所有者等への解任命令はない。
evidence.reasoning_path: supervisor violation -> municipal authority -> owner/manager/occupant -> dismissal order

collision.note: Batch 2 source-defined dismissal trigger; distinct from C023 public-safety-risk trigger.

independent_review.rationale: Article 13-24(1) supports dismissal order when a supervisor violates the Act or orders; distinct enforcement trigger.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 23 accepted candidates cover distinct statutory roles, duties, authorities, temporal boundaries, eligibility routes, enforcement triggers, or emergency obligations. C016 adds insufficient incremental practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
